Name: Patient status on arrival
Description: Ambulatory, bedridden or deceased on arrival; moved from the outpatient consultation form (#566).

Name: Payer
Description: Who settles the bill for this visit (#327). The answer selects the Odoo insurance plan by its payer code (#189).

Name: Supplementary insurance
Description: Supplementary insurance that pays part of what the Payer leaves, e.g. PNB with MFP (#189). The answer selects the Odoo complementary plan by its payer code.
